select p.name, sum(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 as deposit_usd
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
where r.type = 1 and r.status = 2
group by p.name
order by p.name;

select p.name as name,
       sum(r.amount_cents) / 100 as deposit_usd
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
where r.status = 2
  and r.type = 1
group by p.name;

SELECT a.agent_name, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM app.sessions s
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON s.playerid = CAST(p.id AS VARCHAR)
JOIN crm.agents a ON p.agent_code = a.code
GROUP BY a.agent_name
ORDER BY a.agent_name

select t2.agent_name as agent_name, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions t0
join crm.player_accounts t1 on t1.id = cast(t0.playerid as bigint)
join crm.agents t2 on t2.code = t1.agent_code
group by t2.agent_name

select g.title, sum(b.stake_cents) / 100.0 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.games g on g.code = b.game_code
group by g.title;

select g.title, sum(b.stake_cents) / 100 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.games g on g.code = b.game_code
group by g.title;

SELECT p.country AS country, count(*) AS rejected_withdrawals
FROM fin.requests r
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON p.id = r.user_ref
WHERE r.type = 2 AND r.status = 3
GROUP BY p.country;

select
    pa.country as country,
    count(*) as rejected_withdrawals
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts pa on r.user_ref = pa.id
where r.type = 2  -- withdrawal
  and r.status = 3  -- rejected
group by pa.country
order by pa.country;

select count(distinct t1.id) as players
from app.sessions t0
join crm.player_accounts t1 on t1.id = cast(t0.playerid as bigint)
join game.bets t2 on t2.member_ref = t1.id

from crm.agents a
join crm.player_accounts pa on pa.agent_code = a.code
join app.sessions s on cast(s.playerid as bigint) = pa.id
